identity: Glassroot Wilds is the last elven forest before the front: the gate wardens tend the old roots while wolves run the fringe, apes and panthers hold the tangle, and the canopy has a king who answers to nobody.

quests.title: Something Fresh for the Carriers
quests.text: My carriers spend their days beneath living branches and their meals chewing things that have been dead a very long time. Bring me five Melons for their next rest. The roots take years to tend; tending the people who walk them should take a little of our time as well.

variants.text: My carriers spend their days beneath living branches and their meals chewing things that have been dead a very long time. Bring me five Melons for their next rest. The roots take years to tend; tending the people who walk them should take a little of our time as well.

The carriers come back soaked through, set down their loads, and ask whether anything fresh has arrived. Bring me five Melons so I can say yes. Rain in your collar is much easier to forgive with a decent meal in front of you.

quests.lesson: A shared errand, the zone's first; the first armor choice (one enchant, a prefix).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. Draft §3 'Something Fresh for the Carriers': Melons for the carriers (Faeris, Rumela).

quests.title: Keep the Stores Dry
quests.text: The forest is very good at turning neglected supplies into more forest. Bring me three Chests for the stores and spare materials we keep between carrying runs. I would prefer to use our replacement straps before they grow leaves.

variants.text: The forest is very good at turning neglected supplies into more forest. Bring me three Chests for the stores and spare materials we keep between carrying runs. I would prefer to use our replacement straps before they grow leaves.

Recovered belongings have to stay dry until I can return them to their owners. Bring me three Chests for the things waiting here. People are quite capable of being grateful and complaining about the mildew in the same breath.

The rain has found its way into our spare message bindings and the stores beside them. Bring me three Chests so I can put both under proper lids. The next crew should be able to open a message without wringing it out.

quests.lesson: A shared errand, a level only; the zone's early potion choice.
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. Draft §3 'Keep the Stores Dry': dry keeping for stores, personal effects and message gear (Faeris, Orrel, Rumela).

quests.title: Rungs for the High Paths
quests.text: Our carriers wear out the rungs between the grown paths, and rain does the rest. Bring me ten Wooden Ladders to replace them. The roots will outlive us all if we tend them, but I would rather nobody tested that by missing a step.
quests.lesson: A local task; the second armor choice (one enchant, a suffix).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The review's fix (round61-plan.md §2 point 4): Glassroot's own errand for the Accord's sixth armor piece (a Basic recipe, made anywhere; not Melon, not a gated herb).

quests.title: Supplies Through Cinderline
quests.text: Toren Waterbarrel at Cinderline Watch in Ashenward March is trying to keep supplies moving to crews like mine. Speak to him about the work. He understands that a forest path still needs a meal at the end of it.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged); free, it requires nothing.

quests.title: A Path for Those Coming Back
quests.text: Someone has set a snare for the people carrying loads through the {name:canopy}. Loosen it at the {name:carrier_path}, {dir_from_giver:carrier_path}, and report back to me. My wardens can watch that stretch again once they have sound footing. It takes a patient hand to tend these paths and a careless one to make them cruel.
quests.completion: That stretch is passable again, and I can send the wardens to watch it. The next tired carrier will have one less thing waiting for an unsteady foot.
quests.lesson: The zone's solo quest; the weapon choice (prefix and suffix).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. K7 A: the zone's solo quest with its weapon, at a new recipe place in the Canopy, 64 nodes from Canopy-Knuckle (the place rule).

quests.title: Party: The Canopy's Own King
quests.text: {name:canopy_knuckle} has injured my wardens in the {name:canopy} and snapped their bows as though they were fallen twigs. Gather a group and bring him down, {dir_from_giver:canopy_knuckle}. I have tended some of those bow trees longer than he has been alive; my wardens are less replaceable still.
quests.lesson: The optional group quest: free, standalone, a trinket choice as its extra.
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The optional group quest (round61-plan.md §2 point 8): free, standalone, a trinket choice as its extra.

quests.title: Where the Front Begins
quests.text: Nella Hedgeward at Last Hedge Redoubt in Ashenward March needs people for the work beyond our frontier. Go and speak to her if you are ready for it. She asks after the ones who come back, which is a good quality in someone who must send others out.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The departure at 40 (round61-plan.md §2 point 7); free, it requires nothing.
